senses.gloss:
जर a. [जॄ-अप्]
—1 Becoming old or worn out, old, aged.
—2 Wearing out,
—3 Causing old age, producing decay, consuming.

जरा [जॄ-अङ् गुणः] (The word जरस् is optionally substituted
 for जरा before vowel terminations after acc. dual.)
—1 Old age; कैकेयीशङ्कयेवाह पलितच्छद्मना जरा R. 12. 2; तस्य
 धर्मरतेरासीद् वृद्धत्वं जरया (जरसा) विना 1. 23.
—2 Decrepitude, infirmity, general debility consequent on old age.
—3 Praise.
—4 Digestion.
—5 N. of a female demon; see जरासन्ध below.
—6 Invoking, greeting.
.━{@Comp.@}: जरावस्था, जरातुर, जराजीर्ण, जरापुष्ट, जरासन्धः, जरासुतः

जारः [जीर्यत्यनेन जॄ करणे घञ्; जरयतीति जारः Nir.]
—1 A paramour, gallant, lover; रथकारः स्वकां भार्यां सजारां शिरसावहत् Pt. 4. 54.
—2 A confidential friend.

जरठ a. [जॄ बा˚ अठ]
—1 Hard, solid.
—2 old, aged; अयमतिजरठाः प्रकामगुर्वीः परिणतदिक्करिकास्तटीर्बिभर्ति
 Śi. 4. 29 (where जरठ means ‘hard’ also).
—3 Decayed, decrepit, infirm.
—4 Bent, bowed down, drooping.
—5 Pale, yellowish-white.
—6 Full-grown, ripe, matured; जरठकमल Śi. 11. 14.
—7 Hard-hearted, cruel.

जरण a. [जॄ-ल्यु]
—1 Old, decayed, infirm.
—2 Promoting digestion.
जरण + .{@-णः, -णम्@} Cummin seed.
जरण + .{@-णः, -णम्@} Cummin seed.

—1 Causing decay.
—2 Oxydizing of metals.

जारणम् [जॄ-णिच् ल्युट्]
—1 Causing to decay.
—2 Stimulating digestion.
—3 Calcining or oxidizing metals.
—4 A condiment.
जरण्ड a. Decayed, old.
जरण्या Ved. Old age.

जरत् a.
—1 Old, aged, decayed.
—2 Infirm, decrepit. ━m. An old man.
.━{@Comp.@}: जरत्कारुः, जरद्गवः

जरत् + -कारुः N. of a great sage who married a sister of the serpent
 Vāsuki. [One day as he was fallen asleep on the lap of his wife, the sun
 was about to set. His wife, perceiving that the time of offering his evening
 prayers was passing away, gently roused him. But he became angry with
 her for having disturbed his sleep, and left her never to return. He, however,
 told her, as he went, that she was pregnant and would give birth to a
 son who would be her support, and at the same time the saviour of the serpent-race.
 This son was Astika].

जरत् + -गवः an old ox; दारिद्र्यस्य परा मूर्तिर्यन्मानद्रविणाल्पता ।
 जरद्गवधनः शर्वस्तथापि परमेश्वरः ॥ Pt. 2. 163.

जरतिका, -जरती
 An old woman.

जरतिका, -जरती
 An old woman.

—1 An old man.
—2 A buffalo.
जरसानः Man; L. D. B.
जरा + -अवस्था decrepitude.

जरा + -आतुर a.
—1 infirm.
—2 old.
जरा + -जीर्ण a. old through age, debilitated, infirm; Bh. 3. 17.
जरा + -पुष्ट = जरासन्ध. {@-भीरुः@} the god of love, Cupid.

जरा + -सन्धः N. of a celebrated king and warrior, son of Bṛhadratha.
 [According to a legend, he was born divided in two halves which were put
 together by a Rākṣasī called Jarā, whence the boy was called Jarāsandha.
 He became king of Magadha and Chedi after his fatherʼs death. When he
 heard that Kṛṣṇa had slain his son-in-law Kaṃsa, he gathered a large
 army and besieged Mathurā eighteen times, but was as often repulsed.
 When Yudhiṣṭhira performed the great Rājasūya sacrifice, Kṛṣṇa,
 Arjuna and Bhīma went to the capital of Jarāsandha disguised as Brāhmaṇas,
 chiefly with the object of slaying their enemy and liberating the kings
 imprisoned by him. He, however, refused to release the kings, whereupon
 Bhīma challenged him to a single combat. The challenge was accepted;
 a hard fight ensued, but Jarāsandha was at last overpowered and slain by Bhīma.]
जरा + -सुतः Jarāsandha; जरासुतस्तावभिसृत्य माधवौ Bhāg. 10. 50. 21.
जरायणिः N. of Jarāsandha.

जरायु n. [जरामेति इ-ञुण्]
—1 The slough or cast-off skin of a serpent.
—2 The outer skin of the embryo.
[]
—3 After-birth.
—4 Secundines.
—5 The uterus, womb.
.━{@Comp.@}: जरायुज
जरायु + -ज a. born from the womb, viviparous; Ms. 1. 43 and Malli. on Ku. 3. 42.

जरित a. [जरा-इतच्]
—1 Old, aged.
—2 Decayed, infirm; पाण्डुरस्यातपत्रस्य च्छायायां जरितं मया Rām. 2. 2. 7.

जरिन् a. (-णी f.)
 [जरा अस्त्यस्य इनि] Old, aged. ━m. An old man.

जरिमन् m. Ved. Decrepitude, old age; नभो न रूपं जरिमा
 मिनाति Rv. 1. 71. 10.
जरूथ a. [जॄ-ऊथन्] Speaking harshly.
जरूथ + .{@-थः@} N. of a demon conquered by Agni; येभिस्तपोभिरदहो जरूथम् Rv. 7. 1. 7.
जरूथ + .{@-थम्@} Flesh.

जर्च् (-र्छ्, -र्ज्) €1. €6. P.
—1 To say, speak.
—2 To blame, reprove, censure.
—3 To threaten or menace.

जर्च् (-र्छ्, -र्ज्) €1. €6. P.
—1 To say, speak.
—2 To blame, reprove, censure.
—3 To threaten or menace.

जर्च् (-र्छ्, -र्ज्) €1. €6. P.
—1 To say, speak.
—2 To blame, reprove, censure.
—3 To threaten or menace.

जर्जर a. [जर्ज्-बा˚ अर]
—1 Old, infirm, decayed.
—2 Worn out, torn, shattered, broken to pieces, divided in parts, split
 up into thin particles; जराजर्जरितविषाणकोटयो मृगाः K. 21; गात्रं
 जराजर्जरितं विहाय Mv. 7. 18; विसर्पन् धाराभिर्लुठति धरणीं जर्जरकणः
 U. 1. 29; Śi. 4. 23; Māl. 9. 16.
—3 Wounded, hurt.
—4 Pained, tormented; Māl. 9. 53. —5 Dull, hollow (as the sound of a broken vessel).

जर्जरित a. [जर्ज्-णिच् कर्मणि क्त]
—1 Old, decayed, infirm.
—2 Worn out, torn to pieces, shattered, splintered &c.
—3 Completely overpowered, disabled; स्मरशरजर्जरितापि सा प्रभाते Gīt. 8.

जर्जरीक a.
—1 Old, decayed.
—2 Ragged, full of holes, perforated.
जर्जरीकृ €8 U. To wound, disable.

जर्झ् €9. €6. P. (जर्झति)
—1 To say, speak.
—2 To blame.
—3 To threaten, menace.
जर्ण a. [जॄ-नन्] Old, aged, decayed.
जर्तिलः Wild sesamum.

—1 The vulva.
—2 An elephant.

जर्त्स् €1 P. (जर्त्सति)
—1 To say, speak.
—2 To blame, censure, abuse,
—3 To protect.
जर्भरि a. Supporting; सृण्येव जर्भरी तुर्फरीतू Rv. 10. 106. 6.
जर्हिलः = जर्तिल q. v.

जारः + .{@-री@} N. of Durgā.
.━{@Comp.@}: जारजः, जारजन्मन्, जारजातः, जारभरा
जारः + -जः, -जन्मन्, -जातः a bastard; न जारजातस्य ललाटशृङ्गम् Udb.
जारः + -जः, -जन्मन्, -जातः a bastard; न जारजातस्य ललाटशृङ्गम् Udb.
जारः + -जः, -जन्मन्, -जातः a bastard; न जारजातस्य ललाटशृङ्गम् Udb.
जारः + -भरा an adulteress.
जारिणी An adulteress.

जारूथ्य a.
—1 Praiseworthy; निर्गलान् सजारूथ्यान् सर्वान् विविधदक्षिणान् Mb. 9. 49. 3.
—2 In which three kinds of Dakṣiṇā are given; जारूथ्यान् त्रिगुणदक्षिणानित्यर्जुनमिश्रः
 Mb. 3. 291. 70 (com.)
—3 Rich in meat or donations of meat; मांसादिदानप्रधानान् पुष्टानित्यर्थः ibid.

जारक a. [जॄ-णिच् ण्वुल्]
—1 Causing to decay.
—2 Promoting digestion, digestive.

जारद्गव a. (वीथिः) The portion of the moonʼs path occupied
 by the constellations श्रवण, धनिष्ठा and शततारका (according
 to वराहमिहिर); according to others, by विशाखा, अनुराधा and ज्येष्ठा.
